description: Source code for utility functions related to device resources, including resource dumping, value retrieval, input line reading, tokenization, and mode stringification.

methods.name: getResourceDump
methods.description: Generates a string representation of a resource including id, uri, owner, type, mode, and value.

methods.name: getResourceValue
methods.description: Returns the resource's value, masking sensitive resources.

methods.name: getInputLine
methods.description: Reads a line of input from stdin, handling dynamic buffer resizing.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Stores a token extracted from input, handling quotes.

methods.name: getTokenizedInput
methods.description: Splits an input line into tokens, handling quoted strings.

methods.name: stringifyMode
methods.description: Converts resource mode flags into a human-readable string.
